newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs aim for 133.00, must defeat 132.67.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs aim for 133.00, must defeat 132.67.

text.p: September BTP futures traded on LIFFE were on course for 133.00, a key psychological level and also the target from a triangle formation, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
However, they must first break above the new contract high of 132.67 set on Tuesday, which has already thwarted the market in the current session.
"The trend is still intact, even though the momentum has slowed over the last three to four days," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London. "It will have a go at reaching 133.00."
